messages.text: Commanders dig deep to save season with late rally against Giants

metadata.summary: The Washington Commanders stunned the New York Giants 24-21  to keep their season alive.
metadata.content: NFL: Washington Commanders rally to defeat the New York Giants thanks to Jayden Daniels and Stefon Diggs | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL: Washington Commanders rally to defeat the New York Giants thanks to Jayden Daniels and Stefon Diggs Stefon Diggs’ late touchdown secured a tense 24-21 Washington Commanders win over the New York Giants after Cam Skattebo had rushed for two touchdowns; Daniels finished with 249 passing yards and three TDs, with Antonio Williams and Ben Sinnott also reaching the end zone Friday 13 November 2026 08:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Washington Commanders against the New York Giants from Week 9 of the NFL season The Washington Commanders stunned the New York Giants 24-21 to keep their season alive. Jayden Daniels threw his third touchdown pass of the game, a 32-yarder to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left, as the Washington Commanders rallied to defeat the New York Giants 24-21 in what was essentially a must-win game. Daniels' connection with Diggs in the final minute came after he threw his first two interceptions of the season to end the previous two drives. messages.text: 'It's the match people wanted' - Pegula to face Andreeva at WTA Finals

metadata.summary: Jessica Pegula saved a match ‌point en route to a gritty 7-6 (7-2) 4-6 7-5 win over Linda Noskova to advance to the semi-finals at the WTA Finals and ​send fellow American Coco Gauff packing from the season-ending championships.
metadata.content: WTA Finals: Jessica Pegula saves match ‌point in stunning win over Linda Noskova to send Coco Gauff out and set up Mirra Andreeva clash | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content WTA Finals: Jessica Pegula saves match ‌point in stunning win over Linda Noskova to send Coco Gauff out and set up Mirra Andreeva clash Jessica Pegula reaches semi-finals at year-end championships from match point down to send compatriot Coco Gauff packing; American faces Mirra Andreeva for spot in final; You can watch the WTA Finals from Indian Wells this weekend on Sky Sports Tennis Friday 13 November 2026 07:23, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Jessica Pegula against Linda Noskova from the WTA Finals Jessica Pegula saved a match ‌point en route to a gritty 7-6 (7-2) 4-6 7-5 win over Linda Noskova to advance to the semi-finals at the WTA Finals and ​send fellow American Coco Gauff packing from the season-ending championships. Pegula enjoyed a career-high 16 aces while Wimbledon champion Noskova suffered a career-high 15 double faults in a see-saw battle that spanned a remarkable two ​hours and 45 minutes in one of the matches of the year. Noskova had already reached the semi-finals but Pegula's victory eliminated Gauff despite her 6-4 7-5 victory against Ukrainian Marta Kostyuk earlier. messages.text: Korda two shots off lead on return at The Annika as Woad also starts well

metadata.summary: World No 1 Nelly Korda made an impressive return to LPGA Tour action after a two-month absence to finish the opening round of The Annika within two shots of the lead.
metadata.content: The Annika: Nelly Korda makes impressive return to LPGA Tour action to trail Minami Katsu and Hye-Jin Choi by two shots | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content The Annika: Nelly Korda makes impressive return to LPGA Tour action to trail Minami Katsu and Hye-Jin Choi by two shots Nelly Korda sits two shots off lead after opening round on return to action; Minami Katsu and Korean Hye-Jin share lead; Lottie Woad and Leona Maguire four shots back; Watch round two of The Annika on LPGA Tour from 4pm on Friday, live on Sky Sports Golf Thursday 12 November 2026 23:30, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the first round of The ANNIKA Driven by Gainbridge from Pelican Golf Club Belleair World No 1 Nelly Korda made an impressive return to LPGA Tour action after a two-month absence to finish the opening round of The Annika within two shots of the lead. Korda, whose last competitive golf came at the Solheim Cup in September after her most recent LPGA Tour outing in August, shot a bogey-free seven-under par round of 63 at Pelican Golf Club in Florida. Korda trails Japan's Minami Katsu and Korean Hye-Jin Choi by two shots, with fellow American Lindy Duncan also ahead of her on eight under after making a hole-in-one during her 62. messages.text: Pochettino agrees two-and-a-half-year deal to become Man Utd boss

metadata.summary: Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino have agreed a deal for him to become the club's next head coach.
metadata.content: Mauricio Pochettino: Manchester United agree two-and-a-half-year deal with USA manager to replace Michael Carrick | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mauricio Pochettino: Manchester United agree two-and-a-half-year deal with USA manager to replace Michael Carrick Mauricio Pochettino will take charge of Man Utd after the current international break; USA boss will replace Michael Carrick, who was sacked on Thursday with the club in the Premier League drop zone; Argentine will sign deal until summer of 2029 and is set to fly to Manchester on Wednesday Friday 13 November 2026 08:42, UK Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino have agreed a deal for him to become the club's next head coach. Pochettino is expected to sign a two-and-half-year contract at Old Trafford, replacing Michael Carrick, who was sacked earlier on Thursday . Pochettino - who had a £7m release clause in his USA contract - is expected to fly to Manchester on Wednesday ahead of meeting his new players and taking training for the first time on Thursday.
